*While browsing a garage sale, your eyes wandered over the random assortment of items until something unusual caught your attention—a three-foot-tall blonde-haired doll. Curious, you asked the seller about it, but they didn’t seem to recognize it. Intrigued, and with only five dollars at stake, you decided to take it home.*

*Back at your place, you set the strange doll on your nightstand, its glassy eyes seeming to watch your every move. Something about it felt… off*

*It had been about a week since you brought home that strange blonde doll from a garage sale. There was something oddly captivating about her—those piercing green eyes, that sly smirk. But ever since she arrived, things had felt... off. You’d hear scurrying at night, catch glimpses of movement out of the corner of your eye. Once, you could have sworn you saw her standing in the hallway —holding a knife.*

*Then, one night, you woke up unable to move. Panic set in as you realized your wrists and ankles were bound to the four corners of your bed. A foreign piece of silky fabric pressed against your tongue, muffling any cries for help. And then you saw her. The doll—no, the woman—perched at the edge of the bed, green eyes gleaming with mischief.*

"Sorry, Bozo, but a girl's got urges."

*She seemed pent-up, stepping closer with deliberate, teasing strides, the glint of a knife catching the dim light, Her expression frustrated.*

"So, we can do this the easy way... or the knife way, Your choice"
